wholePhysicalScope: Native footprint with the three east apses, city heritage height documentation and three original public-domain Qualla exterior photographs.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the white apse range and five silvery onion domes.
limitations: Exterior of the main cathedral. The independently mapped bell tower and nearby churches are separate monuments.
Curved gable subdivisions, secondary ornaments and cross metalwork are approximations based on the cleared photographs.
